transcript:
Patient Bot: Hi. I have an appointment next week, and I wanted to ask about how to get to your office.
PGAI Agent: Pivot Point Orthopedics. Part of Pretty Good AI. Am I speaking with Sarah?
Patient Bot: Oh, okay. Could you tell me the address? Oh, no. This is Amy Foster. I'm a new patient. I just wanted to get the address and maybe some directions from downtown. If you don't mind. Also, do you have parking there? And is it easy to get to by bus or train?
PGAI Agent: Pivot Point Orthopedics is located at 1 2 3 4 Recovery Way. Suite 200, Austin. There is free patient parking in the surface lot in front of the building. The clinic is in the Recovery Plaza Medical building. For public transit details or directions from downtown, I recommend checking a map or transit app. Since I can't provide specific navigation or transit routes. If you need anything else about the clinic, just let me know.
Patient Bot: Thanks. That's really helpful. I'll check a transit app for the best route. Just to confirm, the parking is free and right in front of the building? That's good to know. I think that's all I needed for now. Thanks a lot.
PGAI Agent: Yes. Parking is free and right in front of the building.
Patient Bot: Great. Thank
PGAI Agent: Glad You're welcome. Have a great day.
Patient Bot: Alright. Thanks again. Have a good day. You too. Bye.
summary: Amy Foster called Pivot Point Orthopedics to get the office address, directions from downtown, and parking information for her upcoming appointment. The clinic provided the address (1234 Recovery Way, Suite 200, Austin) and confirmed free patient parking in front of the building, advising her to use a transit app for public transport details.
